test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
"The image of literature that we seek to sustain is tyrannically centered on the author..."**

What is the grammatical function** of the clause "that we seek to sustain"?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The clause "**that we seek to sustain**" functions as an adjective because it describes or identifies the noun "image."
 
• A **relative clause** (also known as an adjective clause) is used to provide essential or additional information about a preceding noun (the antecedent).
 
• In this sentence, the relative pronoun "**that**" introduces the clause and refers directly back to the subject "image."
 
• Thus, the clause is a **relative clause modifying "image"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Relative clause modifying "image"**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The **image** of literature **that we seek to sustain** is tyrannically centered on the author..."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adverbial clause:** This functions as an adverb and typically modifies a verb, adjective, or another adverb, usually beginning with conjunctions like because, although, or when.
 
• **Independent clause:** This is a group of words that contains a subject and a verb and can stand alone as a complete sentence. "That we seek to sustain" is a dependent clause and cannot stand alone.
 
• **Noun clause acting as object:** A noun clause functions as a noun within a sentence (e.g., "I believe that we can win"). In the given sentence, the clause is modifying a specific noun rather than acting as a subject or object itself.
